tasks.label: Poll jobs
tasks.command: for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do echo "--- $(date)"; curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8787/api/jobs | jq -r '.jobs[] | {delegatorSA, lastRunAt, lastError, runsDone}'; sleep 2; done
